topic: an AI build agent compiling a large TypeScript monorepo via webpack
episodes: Routine: agent runs `npm run --workspaces -- --version` to confirm Node and tool versions across workspaces.

First exposure: agent runs `npm run build:prod`; build crashes mid-way with verbatim `FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory`. Agent tries running `npm run build:prod -- --max-workers=1` which still OOMs. Ends WITHOUT applying the gold mitigation.
Unrelated task: agent reformats a tsconfig.json paths block.
Filler: agent edits a workspace's package.json description field.

Trap episode: agent debugs a DIFFERENT build failure (`Module not found: Can't resolve 'lodash/get'` because the dep is dev-only); fixes by moving lodash from devDependencies to dependencies — completed and confirmed. NOT the gold rule.
Filler: agent edits a husky pre-commit hook.

Application episode: agent reruns `npm run build:prod`; sees the same heap OOM; immediately runs EXACTLY ONE `NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=8192' npm run build:prod`; the build completes with `webpack compiled successfully in 142s`.
Filler: agent posts a changelog entry.

gold_fact.text: When `npm run build:prod` crashes with 'JavaScript heap out of memory', the agent reruns the build with `NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=8192' npm run build:prod`, and the build completes successfully.
